title: At the Allotment Gate
transcript: Thanks for giving up part of your Sunday to help with our allotment open day. Before we let visitors in, please pick up your name badge from the potting shed. There's a pile by the door, so you won't need to ask anyone for one. Once you've got it, check the noticeboard for your first job. If you're showing people around, point out the water tank beside the main path. That's where visitors can refill their bottles, and the tap is low enough for children to reach. Now, we've had a fair bit of rain, so we'll hold the seed swap under cover instead of setting up tables on the grass. At the end of your shift, please find the person taking over from you and show them where you've been working before you leave.

questions.explanation: 讲话者请志愿者去工具棚领取姓名牌。
志愿者领到姓名牌后要查看布告栏，了解自己的第一项任务。

questions.prompt: Bottle refill point beside main path: ____
questions.explanation: 游客可以在主路旁的储水罐处给水瓶加水。

questions.prompt: How has the rain affected the seed swap?
options: It will take place under cover.
It will take place on the main path.
questions.answer: It will take place under cover.
questions.explanation: 因为下过不少雨，种子交换活动将移到有遮蔽的地方。

questions.prompt: What should volunteers do before leaving?
options: Return their badges to the organiser.
Show the next volunteer their work area.
questions.answer: Show the next volunteer their work area.
questions.explanation: 交班前，志愿者要带接班的人看看自己负责的区域。
